ThingDef.label: Electrostaff
ThingDef.description: An electrostaff was a staff-like melee weapon manufactured by Baktoid Armor Workshop and Holowan Mechanicals. They were used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems' IG-100 MagnaGuard.

ThingDef.label: Vibroblade
ThingDef.description: A vibroblade, also styled as vibro-blade, was a bladed knife used for basic utility needs or as a melee weapon.

ThingDef.label: Vibrosword
ThingDef.description: Like all vibro-weapons, it was dangerous to use vibroswords against electrical weapons, as they conducted electricity, therefore, electrocuting the user of the sword.

ThingDef.label: Vibroaxe
ThingDef.description: The Vibroaxe is a close-combat weapon in the Star Wars universe, featuring a heavy, hand-held axe with a vibroblade that can cut through armor and hard materials. It is often used by soldiers and mercenaries, and requires strength and skill to wield effectively.

ThingDef.label: SE-14 Light Blaster Pistol
ThingDef.description: The SE-14 was used by the B1-Series battle droids of the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars and was referred to as the Separatist blaster pistol.

ThingDef.label: E-5 Blaster Rifle
ThingDef.description: The E-5 blaster rifle was manufactured by Baktoid Armor Workshop on order from the Trade Federation for their Droid Army.

ThingDef.label: E-5C Blaster Rifle
ThingDef.description: The E-5C blaster rifle was manufactured by Baktoid Armor Workshop on order from the Trade Federation for their Droid Army.

ThingDef.label: E-5S Sniper Rifle
ThingDef.description: The E-5s sniper rifle was a 4-shot rifle produced by Baktoid Armor Workshop and used by the Battle droid assassins of the Trade Federation and the Separatist Droid Army.

ThingDef.label: EE-3 Carbine Rifle
ThingDef.description: It was an optically fitted blaster rifle capable of three-round burst fire at long ranges, but had lower accuracy and stopping power compared to larger rifles

ThingDef.label: E-60R Missile Launcher
ThingDef.description: Baktoid Armor Workshop E-60R missile launchers were anti-armor projectile pieces used by assault battle droids.

ThingDef.label: B2 Super Droid Wrist Blaster
ThingDef.description: Built-in double blaster cannon (Wrist blaster).

ThingDef.label: B2-HA Super Droid Wrist Cannon
ThingDef.description: Built-in Snigle blaster cannon.

ThingDef.label: Droidekas Blaster
ThingDef.description: Two twin built-in blaster cannons

ThingDef.label: Droideka Long Blaster
ThingDef.description: Long Blaster made for the Droideka sniper

ThingDef.label: AQ Battle Blaster
ThingDef.description: built-in blaster cannons for AQ battle Droid

ThingDef.label: DSD1 Dwarf Spider Blaster
ThingDef.description: built-in blaster cannons for dwarf spiders

ThingDef.label: LR-57 Combat Blaster
ThingDef.description: In-build blaster for LR-57 Droid

ThingDef.label: DC-17 Blaster Pistol
ThingDef.description: Like all blasters of the DC-line manufactured by BlasTech Industries, the DC-17 hand blaster fired blue plasma projectiles that were hyper-ionized to be especially devastating against droids while retaining its lethality against organic beings.

ThingDef.label: DC-17S Blaster Pistol
ThingDef.description: Like all blasters of the DC-line manufactured by BlasTech Industries. Base on the DC-17 Blaster pistol with an extender.

ThingDef.label: DC-17M Blaster Rifle
ThingDef.description: The DC-17M blaster with a higher rate of fire.

ThingDef.label: DC-15S Blaster Rifle
ThingDef.description: Smaller in scale than the DC-15A blaster rifle, the DC-15S blaster lacked its larger cousin's range, but was easier to handle than its bulkier cousin with a higher rate of fire.

ThingDef.label: DC-15A Blaster Rifle
ThingDef.description: The DC-15A blaster rifle was one of the standard issue weapons for clone troopers. While the use of blasters allowed a clone trooper to carry significantly more ammunition than a projectile weapon.

ThingDef.label: DC-15x Sniper Rifle
ThingDef.description: It was a modified version of the DC-15A sniper rifle, dealing more damage, but containing less shots.

ThingDef.label: Z6 Rotary Blaster Cannon
ThingDef.description: The Z-6 rotary blaster cannon was a powerful rotating blaster cannon chaingun developed by Merr-Sonn Munitions.

ThingDef.label: Thermal Detonator
ThingDef.description: Thermal detonators were palm-sized, spherical devices that were used as extremely deadly explosive weapons.

ThingDef.label: ECD Grenade
ThingDef.description: Electrostatic Charge Detonator,ECD, and often referred to by Republic clone troopers as droid poppers.

ThingDef.label: Westar-33 Blaster Pistol
ThingDef.description: The Westar-33 is a blaster pistol used in Star Wars that fires energy bolts and is popular among soldiers and bounty hunters. It has a moderate rate of fire and small ammo capacity, but is reliable and durable.

ThingDef.label: Westar-34 Blaster Pistol
ThingDef.description: The WESTAR-34 blaster pistol was a model of blaster pistol manufactured by Concordian Crescent Technologies.

ThingDef.label: Westar-35 Blaster Pistol
ThingDef.description: The WESTAR-35 blaster pistol was a model of blaster pistol manufactured by Concordian Crescent Technologies.

ThingDef.label: Westar-44 Heavy Blaster Pistol
ThingDef.description: The WESTAR-44 blaster pistol was a model of blaster pistol manufactured by Concordian Crescent Technologies.

ThingDef.label: Westar-M5 Blaster Rifle
ThingDef.description: They were mainly used by the Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commandos during the later years of the conflict.

ThingDef.label: M-56 Heavy Blaster Cannon
ThingDef.description: The M-56 Heavy Blaster Cannon is a powerful weapon used in the Star Wars universe. It is a heavy-duty blaster that fires concentrated bolts of energy and is capable of causing significant damage to its target. The M-56 is often mounted on vehicles, such as speeder bikes or starfighters, and can also be carried and used by infantry soldiers. It has a high rate of fire and a large ammo capacity, making it a formidable weapon on the battlefield. Despite its destructive capabilities, the M-56 is difficult to handle due to its size and weight, requiring a strong and skilled operator to use it effectively.

ThingDef.label: Amban Blaster Rifle
ThingDef.description: The Amban phase-pulse blaster, also known as an Amban sniper rifle, was a type of disruptor sniper rifle used by the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin.
